# Health

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(quartoReactive)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
source("data.R")

health <- health_data()
latest <- health[health$year == 2024, c("code", "name", "good_health")]
```

An inline copy of the selector; it must stay in sync with the sidebar.

```{r}
#| echo: false
qr_select("gemeente", choices, label = "Compare municipalities")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
plot_ly(qr_data(health, "code", "gemeente"), x = ~year, y = ~good_health, color = ~name,
        type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
datatable(qr_data(latest, "code", "gemeente"), rownames = FALSE)
```
